## Frequently Asked Questions

What are Gift Kits and what could I use them for?

A gift kit or gift hamper is a curated collection of personalized products to gift colleagues, clients, teams, promotions, giveaways, and corporate communities. It is also a smart way to get your brand or company name out there, through gifts like sipper bottles, backpacks, diaries, and hoodies!
Personalized gift kits with brand swag & goodies are unique ways to engage customers or employees in the hybrid-work world. We can drop-ship your gifts with [PrintoSe](https://lp.printo.in/printose/) globally and pan-India.

Can we change products from the existing kit/ hamper?

The gift kits are curated and standardized, however, if you're looking for a custom kit to fit a certain team style, occasion or budget, [fill out the form](https://lp.printo.in/newyear-gifting/)

and our customer team will get back to you with the best possible solution. You may also visit our [retail stores](https://printo.in/stores) across the country.

Is it possible to print on the gift box?

In our standard catalog, all gift kits come in a box with a sleeve. The design uploaded or shared by the customer is printed on the sleeve of the box. If you are looking to print directly on the box, we recommend filling out [this form](https://lp.printo.in/newyear-gifting/) and we will customize it for you, with additional charges.

Is there any warranty on the branded product?

Yes, all branded products have a standard warranty as per the brand norms. In case of any issues, we recommend reaching out to the brand's service center for further assistance.

Can we place an order for any individual product?

No, you cannot place an order for individual products (eg: gourmet etc.) as prices will vary based on the MOQ (minimum order quantity), and type of packaging/ branding requirement. If you are looking for any changes, please fill out [this form](https://lp.printo.in/newyear-gifting/) and we will come back with the best possible solution.

Not looking for a kit but a simple corporate gift? Explore our range of standard [corporate gifts here](https://printo.in/categories/corporate-gifting) Photo Mugs and Mouse Pads are customer favorites starting as low as Rs 299.

How does my business benefit from giving personalized business kits/hampers?

Gifting helps establish, build and strengthen client and customer relationships, while branded presents serve as a form of marketing, to promote your brand and its products or services. For employees, this means reduced attrition and for clients & communities, this means brand loyalty. Both lead to only good things for your business!

Is branding available in the Gifting Kit?

Yes! Whether you’re looking for branding, customization or personalization, we’re here to help. To make each gift unique and enforce a feeling of brand recognition, we can customize your kits. The printing specifications are mentioned in detail in the catalogue.

Will there be any change in the MOQ (minimum order quantity) if we add anything additional to the kit?

Yes, the MOQ (minimum order quantity) depends on the type of changes/ customization required. Our present MOQ is being optimized as per the standard kits. We recommend filling out [this form](https://lp.printo.in/newyear-gifting/) and we will get back to you with the best possible customized solution.

Can we print on the inner pages of diaries?

No, branding is limited to the top cover of the diary alone. For any additional changes in the inner pages, please fill out [this form](https://lp.printo.in/newyear-gifting/) and we will provide you with the best possible customized solution.

If we have a list of addresses, will you drop ship it to our employees/ clients/ customers?

Yes, we have an end-to-end global delivery platform, [PrintoSe](https://lp.printo.in/printose/) that helps in door-to-door shipment along with returns. It is an automated platform which makes the drop shipment process seamless at an efficient cost. We also have tie-ups with multiple courier companies who help us deliver millions of packages on a regular basis.

### Boost Team Morale with Thoughtful Employee Engagement Kits from Printo!

Employee engagement is key to a productive and motivated workforce, and Printo offers tailored employee engagement kits designed to inspire and delight your team. With an emphasis on utility and personalization, these kits combine practicality with creativity to foster a positive workplace environment.

What's Inside the Employee Engagement Kit?
Our engagement kits include a mix of essential and premium items, perfect for building camaraderie and maintaining team spirit:

\- Branded stationery, including Notebooks and customized pens
\- Personalized corporate gifts, such as branded coffee mugs, diaries, and more
\- These kits can also be tailored with your corporate logo design for a cohesive brand presence.

### Versatile Printo's Employee Engagement Kits

Printo's employee engagement kits are versatile and can be curated to suit various events and milestones:

\- Corporate Diwali gifts to celebrate the festive spirit
\- Welcome kits for new hires or special days like anniversaries or birthdays
\- Gifts for team-building activities, rewards, and recognition programs
\- Items to promote company initiatives or campaigns

### Why Choose Printo?

\- Customization at its best: Add your branding to every item, from corporate bags to office board designs.
\- Enhanced engagement: Create meaningful connections with gifts tailored to your team's needs.
\- Professional appeal: High-quality products that reflect the professionalism of your workplace.

Looking for something more? Explore:
\- Corporate invitation templates for team events or celebrations
\- Banners and signage, such as corporate gifts banners and office sign boards, to complement your kits
